name: mcpText
description: Builds a text MCP content block. The block passes through the automatic result coercion untouched, so use it when a tool wants exact control over what the client renders. Returns a struct with type = "text" and the given text.

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Content helpers for exact control over MCP responses.

examples.title: Return a text content block
examples.description: A tool can return an explicit content block instead of relying on automatic coercion.
